method: Paraphrased web-derived observations only; original download outcomes separately recorded.

sources.observation: Highway-visible advertising definition has category exclusions; face-change definition distinguishes panel replacement from copy/poster/vinyl change. Definitions are not independent electrical exemptions.

Lawful nonconforming status requires historical evidence; enlargement, relocation, replacement and damage rules have exceptions. Do not infer grandfathered status or removal obligation from existence alone.
Interstate standards control when sign visible from multiple highways including Interstate; address-specific sightline/road classification review required.
Denial/revocation/suspension requires written notice with reasons and takes immediate effect in published text; not proof of any actual permit action.
Intent addresses interstate/primary-highway safety and visual blight; does not grant sign permission.

Maintenance, installer identification, lighting shielding, access/traffic protection and ROW provisions apply within chapter scope. Published 70 foot-candle sign-face limit is not universal luminance limit for every sign.

Annual inspection and violation notice/hearing provisions; written hearing request 30-day candidate. Text says filed with Board while hearing names directors: recipient ambiguity unresolved; no operational appeal deadline approved.

Cafe intent limits section to literal O-B 2 and B-3 districts; O-B 2 wording differs from publisher district index B-2 Office District. Do not silently normalize district label or infer parcel eligibility.
Published fourth-degree misdemeanor and separate daily offense language; no penalty assessment automated.

chapter_observation_coverage.meaning: All indexed sections observed across review packets; not adopted/current/archived code completeness.
